experiences_note: Experience.embedding is #[serde(skip)] in the published crate (stored separately in the EMBEDDINGS table, copy-through / not re-encoded), so the typed experience records below carry NO embedding field — the per-experience embedding ground truth is the genuine on-disk bytes under raw_stored_bytes.embeddings, keyed by experience_id.
falsification_contract: A corrupted or truncated real-v0.7.0.redb MUST fail loudly downstream: this fixture's blob_sha256 (provenance AC) + the corrupt/truncated-fixture negative tests together guarantee a mutated/truncated blob fails rather than silently passing.

feature_set.note: `sync` enabled (in-memory transport + SyncManager for the cursor row); builtin-embeddings/ort NOT enabled; embeddings injected via the External provider.

migration_axes_note: v0.7.0 is already {redb-v3, postcard, schema-v4}: the redb file-format and codec axes are NOT exercised by this fixture (see real-v0.5.1 / real-v0.4.0). It exercises the schema v4→v5 sync-cursor split + reset (r1.s1.w1, issue #9) and the .pre-v5.bak sidecar.
provenance_note: Mechanical provenance (audit C1): blob_sha256 is recomputed + compared by 4.01's AUTO provenance AC; a mutated/truncated blob fails that check loudly. generator_git_commit + generator_cargo_lock_sha256 + resolved_dependency_checksums + build_env pin the exact generation environment. The generator is committed for provenance but is NOT run in CI (4.02 runs the upgrade test against the FROZEN blob).

raw_stored_bytes.note: GENUINE on-disk bytes of the copy-through tables, read back via redb 4.x directly (audit C4). The upgrade test asserts these survive migration byte-identically.

sync_cursor.note: GENUINE 0.7.0 cursor persisted by one SyncManager::sync_once over the in-memory transport. The schema-v5 migration (0.8.0) rewrites this row as {instance_id, push_sequence: 0, pull_sequence: 0} under a .pre-v5.bak sidecar; the upgrade test asserts the reset against these raw bytes.
